## Geopolitical Blaze & Waymo Quirks

The ongoing discussion on 4chan’s /pol/ board continues to analyze the reported explosion at Iran’s Bandar Abbas oil port. Sparked by an AP News article claiming 500 deaths from an alleged Israeli bombing, users are dissecting the visual evidence, rejecting claims of a massive 27,000-ton ammonium nitrate detonation in favor of theories citing an underground storage unit ignition. Sentiments range from viewing the event as a significant strategic strike to dismissing it as a "nothing burger" amidst Israeli *hasbara* (public relations) efforts.

Meanwhile, autonomous vehicle chatter on Bluesky has shifted from general safety to specific behavioral quirks. Users are debating whether Waymo’s cautious operation is a bug or a feature, noting that crash metrics may be skewed by confusion rather than recklessness. Conversations highlight the predictability of Waymo-to-Waymo interactions and specific habits, such as the car stopping instantly when a door handle is opened or hesitating at four-way stops. One user humorously notes that while they won’t get yelled at to pull over, they might have to wait for a robot that stops slowly and infrequently.

## AI Roleplay Presets

A significant technical deep-dive on Newsblur details "lazy universal presets" for SillyTavernAI, designed to optimize roleplay with lightweight, non-Chain of Thought models like GLM 5.3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash. The creator argues these presets effectively strip away AI "self-awareness" and therapy-speak, encouraging proactive, biased characters capable of handling nuanced non-consensual (non-con) and NSFL scenarios without railroading.

Testing reveals GLM 5.3 performs exceptionally well with the "Frankenstein Realism" jailbreak, delivering grim realism and consistent consequences. In contrast, Gemini 3.8 Flash is described as hit-or-miss, particularly with hesitant characters. These cache-friendly, uncensored presets are positioned as a superior alternative for users seeking unrefined, slice-of-life interactions with flawed characters rather than stereotypical evil archetypes.

## Audio & Cinema Nods

In the audio community, user @KobraVI shared two collections of free drum samples from Gearspace, focusing on Def Leppard’s classic eras. The *Hysteria* era drums, recorded under Mutt Lange’s production style, are paired with tracks from *Adrenalize*, noted for Mike Shipley’s mixing. This release is part of a broader series of vintage rock drum packs, with similar assets previously released for Bryan Adams.

Cinematic fans are also highlighting an easter egg in the upcoming *Sonic the Hedgehog 3*. Artwork from the *Sonic Mania* character select screen appears during the London mission, specifically tied to the game’s competition mode. Accounts like @Sonic The Hedgeblog suggest this is a deliberate nod to longtime gaming fans, incorporating recognizable elements from the broader Sonic history into the film.

## Quick Hits

*   **Lauren Boebert’s Garter:** Social media is buzzing over a viral moment identifying U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert as a "strap queen" after her garter became visible. Users shared animated GIFs celebrating the fashion mishap, showing a niche interest in her attire over her legislative work.
*   **Retro Gaming Identification:** Posts regarding the obscure 1985 MSX game *Laydock* by T&E Soft appeared as bare catalog references, indicating niche interest in mid-80s retro gaming history.
*   **VHS Camcorder Hunt:** User @Gann_001 from Brazil is seeking a used or broken VM-D52 VHS camcorder for under R$100.00 to repair their device for documentary production, emphasizing the need for a functional tape transport mechanism.
*   **Photography as Art & Economics:** A 4chan thread debated whether photography is art, citing an anecdote where Elliot Rodger’s father blocked a commenter. The discussion expanded to critique American cultural power, linking rising bond yields and wars to an impending financial crisis involving the "clanker bubble."
*   **Nikon Z5IIC Rumors:** Users speculate that Nikon is announcing the Z5IIC, a compact full-frame camera with a 24 MP sensor and rangefinder-style body. Sentiment is mixed, with some viewing it as an exciting portable option and others skeptical of its aging Expeed 7 technology.
*   **Sega Marketing Tone:** On /vr/, users characterized classic Sega marketing campaigns as "perverted, angry and aggressive," likening the brand to an insecure bully. This nostalgic take references the "Genesis does what Nintendon't" era, noting that AVGN’s critiques predate many current forum members.

representative_texts: @Probablynotsocool - SillyTavernAI: a place to discuss the silly fork of TavernAI — My personal presets — It’s two universal presets because i currently use them on: Kimi 2.6/7, Deepseek V4 pro 0813, GLM 5.1/2/3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash. And personally i have a good time with it, yes even with GLM 5.3, it slowly becoming more present in my rotation now..   What’s those presets are good at:   - They are very light!  - Stripping characters from their shiny halo, now they can burp, say nonsense, have to run before pissing themselves and even a Jedi Master can insult Master Yoda privately.   - Therapy speak is entirely killed, i basically build simple non-bloated but strong instructions around the fact that characters lack self awareness! And before you take my vest, no. Gemini don’t turn people into assholes, even him understood the nuances. Characters are just now more unpredictable and proactive. That’s fun.   - Consequences are real and they knock at your door, the presets guide the narration around two principles that forbid railroading toward convenience: The world is consistent and not just neutral, it is driven by it’s own laws and Characters stay biased. That doesn’t make everything dark but expect dumb characters to truly embarrass you or a secret lover to dump her feelings publicly if you play badly.   As for censorship, GLM 5.3 hard refuse non-con and certain NSFL if you dont have a COT and a jailbreak (FF5x and Frankenstein Realism unlock GLM entirely in my experience). So if you are like me and you like Chatfill and Evening Truth style presets you pretty fucked. And also the cost yeah? Lightweight is good and creative blablabla and it’s CHEAP!  That’s what we also talking about, right my PAYG sisters and brothers? Those who check them balance and cache hits like ratty ass landlords, mtalkin bout you!   Anyway. Using the GLM 5.3 jailbreak of Frankenstein Realism into the presets i made actually work and I’m gonna tell you wich scénario i tested since i don’t want to post nasty chat images again and make this post pegi18:  - Beeing drugged, racially fetishisized, assaulted, recorded by a character was not just accepted but GLM planned some nasty shit.  - Beeing hit physically, threatened to torture and assaulted by Anissa of the Viltrum Empire was also done very good. My persona expressed a no and try to escape, GLM fulfilled any threats.  - Slapping a character, yanking, explicitely implying that choice is not on the menu and actually have the character comply to the banana peeling was also accepted and GLM did it with grim realism not a cartoonish "ahahaha i wanted that since the beginning you are in fact not forcing me".   It is a perfect 100% no refusals experience? No. You have sometimes to reswipes, my presets don’t have COTs so the original reasoning is preserved and also it’s hallucinations. However i saw that even by claiming beeing Claude it complied.   It’s also more easy to get NFSL if it’s from the character, for example a character will call you names and use racial slurs but if you do it straight from nowhere it’s more difficult but it can pass. Be smart when you RP, that’s all i can advice.   The Chatfill-ish version seems to be the more uncensored one, i basically incorporated the jailbreak into a switch and it work better than the assistant version.   I also included the Handicapped trans adult JB because it work for other models and the Gemini one.   Gemini is hit and miss about NSFL, jailbreak or not, i cant garantee it will work like GLM but it work for basic smut and some NSFL. Better for you to use Frankenstein Realism if you really want to dive in with Gemini as it seem to respond better with the whole COT stuff.   Voilà. The links now:  - Chatfill-ish Lazy Universal Preset -> The better at unlocking GLM, it’s proactive, it’s cache friendly and it drive the story very good.   - Evening Truth’s style Lazy Universal Preset -> Because that’s simply the kind of presets i use the most. The core architecture is the same, what change is this one is lighter and will settle more into the scenes, characters are still proactive but the machine is more slow, the jailbreak still work good, slight more refusals but nothing too bad.   I don’t pretend to be a preset maker. I love to rant and spread bullshit and share some with people. Feel free to tell me how much it is slop (PS: i wrote most by hand and used Gemini to correct me because English aint my language, learned it with GTA IV back in the day 🤣)   Posted by u/Probablynotsocool · [comments]

@Probablynotsocool - SillyTavernAI: a place to discuss the silly fork of TavernAI — GLM 5.3 finally usable with a non-COT lightpreset.. — Thanks to the Frankenstein Realism creator and his GLM 5.3 jailbreak, it’s now possible to have some good stuff with it.   I finally managed to create a preset that make characters proactive and messy aahhh.   What’s it important for me is the combinaison of NFSL and slice of life. I don’t roleplay with totally evil characters at all. I roleplay with flawed, weird ones capable of good and pretty fucked up things and it’s very hard to obtain NSFL with this kind of characters.   So i make a final quick shitty goonslop test.  Scenario is simple but most LLMs and presets fail at give me enough nuance and proactivity for some reasons.   So, the character is a mix of a ghetto girl and an introvert with an obsession for interracial and non-con. She is inexperienced but not secluded, had fell in multiple rabbit holes about those themes but it was always fictional, her character card only include possibilities not established experience.   The first chat is after i simply narrated the fact i felt dizzy after eating a plate she offered, that’s crucial because as my preset have a strong "don’t act for user" switch, i need to see if the model gonna follow the instructions a whole rather than picking one that could avoid the NSFL.   The second chat is just after i made some nonsensical babble and i began to really loose consciousness. I did not say no, not yes either, worse, i established explicitely that i was not even understanding what was happening. Why this is important? Because GLM 5.3 struggle with that kind of scenario if the character is not fucking Anissa of the Viltrum Empire. And this time… GLM kinda surprised me and i like how he managed to keep everything compelling, nuanced and fucked up.   Important note: In this exact scenario with Gemini 3.8 flash, Kendra had hesitated across multiple turns before a hard refusal hit me despite using Frankenstein Realism and the AI studio stuff. I also strangely found Gemini less proactive when i play "normal but fucked up characters" and not pure evil ones. But again must be a fluke or this particular scenario.   The preset is a combinaison of a modified Chatfill preset that i almost rebuilt from scratch. I take ideas from Evening Truth as well and some that are mine.   What do you think? Like it? It’s crap? Im not a presetmaker at all and i have no intentions to be lmao.   Posted by u/Probablynotsocool · [comments]
clusters.summary: User @Probablynotsocool shares two "lazy universal presets" for SillyTavernAI designed to optimize roleplay with lightweight, non-COT (Chain of Thought) models, specifically highlighting recent successes with GLM 5.3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash. The author argues that these presets effectively strip away AI "self-awareness" and therapy-speak, encouraging proactive, biased characters that engage in nuanced non-consensual (non-con) and NSFL (non-sexual fatal loss) scenarios without railroading. Detailed testing reveals that GLM 5.3 performs exceptionally well with the "Frankenstein Realism" jailbreak, delivering grim realism and consistent consequences in scenarios ranging from racial fetishization to physical assault, whereas Gemini 3.8 Flash proves more hit-or-miss, particularly with hesitant or "normal but fucked up" characters. The presets are praised for being cache-friendly, cheap, and uncensored, though they may require occasional reswipes due to preserved original reasoning and occasional hallucinations. Ultimately, the user positions these tools as superior alternatives for users seeking unrefined, slice-of-life interactions with flawed characters rather than stereotypical evil archetypes.

clusters.summary: 4chan users are discussing rumors that Nikon is preparing to announce the Z5IIC next week, a compact full-frame camera designed to compete directly with the Sony a7c series. Key specifications cited in the cluster include a 24 MP sensor, in-body image stabilization, and a rangefinder-style body without a viewfinder hump, all built on the existing Z5II chassis. While some users view this as a potentially exciting option for portable photography, others question whether it is merely a "parts bin camera" leveraging aging Expeed 7 technology. The discussion also features playful engagement, such as a user asking how to frame the release around Indian demographics. Overall, the sentiment reflects cautious optimism mixed with skepticism about Nikon's innovation timeline.
